This recheck obtained the pricing page's real content and its WordPress REST payload through the reader route - a materially different authorized route - establishing that the official Standard Services Price Guide page exists with two price-guide links, while the exact /cms-hpt.txt pointer and both direct routes remain Cloudflare-blocked with identical 403 behavior.
